newsitem.title: USA: Bon-ton Stores to close five stores.
newsitem.headline: Bon-ton Stores to close five stores.

text.p: The Bon-Ton Stores Inc said it will will close five stores on January 11.
After these closings, the Bon-Ton will operate 64 stores.
The company said the move was part of its effort to eliminate underperforming assets. The store are in Johnstown, Frackville and Washington, Penn., Cortland, N.Y., and Fairmont, West Va.
As previously announced, the Pennsylvania and West Virginia stores, acquired from Hess Department Stores Inc in September 1994, had been targeted for short-term operation only.
The Bon-Ton will continue to serve local customers from nearby store locations. Our store closure review is now complete and there are no plans to close additional stores in fiscal 1996.

The Bon-Ton operates 69 department stores in middle and secondary markets in Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, West Virginia, New Jersey and Georgia. The stores carry broad assortments of brand-name fashions and accessories for women, men and children, as well as home furnishings. -0-
